outcome: Mitochondrial respiratory parameters (maximal respiration, spare capacity)
Expression of mitochondrial electron transport chain (ETC) complexes I to V
Expression of antioxidant enzymes (superoxide dismutase 1 or 2, glutathione peroxidase)
cohort: Placentas were collected at term by cesarean delivery from obese (first trimester BMI >=30, n = 10) or lean (BMI < 25, n = 6) women.
finding: In trophoblasts from obese women, melatonin (10 and 100 umol/L) significantly increased maximal respiration and spare capacity, and decreased the elevated expression of glutathione peroxidase back to levels seen in trophoblasts of lean women.
